mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 6-month moving average compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0% and remains elevated for two consecutive months, it signals weakening labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 5.0% for 2 consecutive months), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by at least 1% from their prior month values, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of sustained industrial production growth (INDPRO > 120 for 3 consecutive months), supply chain bottlenecks ease and corporate profit margins expand, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 120 for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.0% for two consecutive months, it triggers a hawkish monetary policy response that increases real interest rates and depresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% for 2 consecutive months), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 150,000 per month signals robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 150,000 for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 2,100,000 units annually, it indicates strong consumer confidence and increased household spending, which boosts corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances (HOUST > 2100.0 annualized), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) above 115 for three consecutive months indicates improving supply chain efficiency and manufacturing output, which enhances corporate profitability and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 115 for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
